shots.text: Before the Hush, Veyra forgot nothing.
Not a face, not a name, not a single life was ever lost.
Beneath the city stood the Reliquary, an engine of crystal and runes.
Every memory of every citizen was kept inside it.
It was built by the king who ended the Long War.
His name was Aurelian.
The war had lasted forty years. He ended it in one winter.
It cost him his army, his brother, and the last of his youth.
But peace needed someone to blame for the dead.
The new council named him the butcher of the war he had ended.
His sentence was the cruelest Veyra had ever known: the Unwriting.
Through the Reliquary, every memory of him was torn from every mind.
His statues fell. His name was chiseled from the stone.
Even those who loved him forgot he had ever lived.
For twenty years, he wandered the ruins beyond the wall.
Once, he came back in secret, to see his daughter.
She looked straight at him, and saw a stranger.
That was the day his grief became hatred.
He did not come back for his throne.
He came back for the crystal that held his name.
They had taught him what the engine could do. Now he would teach them.
That night, every light in Veyra went dark.
The world fell silent. We call it the Hush.
Since then, every night, one of us is unremembered.
They still live, but no one can recall their face.
From what is taken, the King shapes monsters: the Hollows.
Steel passes through a Hollow like smoke.
Only a memory can wound a memory.
So we learned to burn our own. We call it Echo.
Seven years after the Hush.
